variants.name: 環境変数を - の並びで書く

connect:
services:
  web:
    image: city-reserve:2.0
    ports:
      - 8080:3000
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres@db:5432/reserve
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: city-db:1.0
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

volumes:
  db-data:

variants.name: 初めは db をつなぐだけ・次にボリュームを足す

connect:
# 予約の窓口（web）と DB（db）を一緒に動かす
services:
  db:
    image: "city-db:1.0"
  web:
    image: "city-reserve:2.0"
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_started
    ports:
      - "8080:3000"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://postgres@db:5432/reserve"
keep:
# 予約の窓口（web）と DB（db）を一緒に動かす
services:
  db:
    image: "city-db:1.0"
    volumes:
      - "db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data"
  web:
    image: "city-reserve:2.0"
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_started
    ports:
      - "8080:3000"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://postgres@db:5432/reserve"
volumes:
  db-data: {}
